questions.q: In DNA, which base always pairs with adenine (A)?
questions.qAf: Watter basis paar in DNS altyd met adenien (A)?
questions.explain: A always pairs with T, and G always pairs with C. This lets DNA be copied accurately when cells divide.
questions.explainAf: A paar altyd met T, en G paar altyd met C. Dit laat DNS akkuraat kopieer wanneer selle verdeel.

questions.q: How many chromosomes are in a normal human body cell?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel chromosome is in 'n normale menslike liggaamsel?
questions.explain: Humans have 46 chromosomes in 23 pairs, one of each pair from each parent. Pair 23 is the sex chromosomes.
questions.explainAf: Mense het 46 chromosome in 23 pare, een van elke paar van elke ouer. Paar 23 is die geslagschromosome.

questions.q: On about which day of a 28-day menstrual cycle does ovulation happen?
questions.qAf: Op ongeveer watter dag van 'n 28-dae menstruele siklus vind ovulasie plaas?
questions.explain: Days 1–5 are menstruation, the lining rebuilds on days 6–13, and on about day 14 a surge of LH releases a mature egg from the ovary.
questions.explainAf: Dae 1–5 is menstruasie, die voering bou op dae 6–13 weer op, en op ongeveer dag 14 laat 'n skielike toename in LH 'n volwasse eiersel uit die eierstok vry.

questions.q: An atom has 16 electrons, arranged 2,8,6. In which period is it, and how many valence electrons does it have?
questions.qAf: 'n Atoom het 16 elektrone, gerangskik 2,8,6. In watter periode is dit, en hoeveel valenselektrone het dit?
questions.explain: Three shells means Period 3, and the 6 electrons in the outer shell are the valence electrons. It is sulfur.
questions.explainAf: Drie doppe beteken Periode 3, en die 6 elektrone in die buitenste dop is die valenselektrone. Dit is swael.

questions.q: Metals conduct electricity well. How does metallic bonding explain this?
questions.qAf: Metale gelei elektrisiteit goed. Hoe verduidelik metaalbinding dit?
options: A 'sea' of delocalised electrons can move freely through the metal
The metal atoms share pairs of electrons in molecules
The ions are locked in place
optionsAf: 'n "See" van gedelokaliseerde elektrone kan vrylik deur die metaal beweeg
Die metaalatome deel elektronpare in molekules
Die ione is in hul plek vasgevang
questions.explain: In metallic bonding the valence electrons are released into a shared pool that flows freely, carrying charge when a voltage is applied.
questions.explainAf: By metaalbinding word die valenselektrone in 'n gedeelde poel vrygestel wat vrylik vloei en lading dra wanneer 'n spanning aangelê word.

questions.q: Copper oxide (CuO) neutralises acids but is not called an alkali. Why?
questions.qAf: Koperoksied (CuO) neutraliseer sure, maar word nie 'n alkali genoem nie. Waarom?
options: It does not dissolve in water
optionsAf: Dit los nie in water op nie
questions.explain: All alkalis are bases, but only bases that dissolve in water are alkalis. CuO is insoluble, so it is a base but not an alkali.
questions.explainAf: Alle alkalieë is basisse, maar net basisse wat in water oplos, is alkalieë. CuO is onoplosbaar, dus is dit 'n basis maar nie 'n alkali nie.

questions.q: Who discovered electromagnetic induction in 1831?
questions.qAf: Wie het elektromagnetiese induksie in 1831 ontdek?
questions.explain: Faraday (and, independently, Joseph Henry) discovered that a changing magnetic field induces a current. Ørsted showed in 1820 that a current makes a magnetic field.
questions.explainAf: Faraday (en, onafhanklik, Joseph Henry) het ontdek dat 'n veranderende magneetveld 'n stroom induseer. Ørsted het in 1820 gewys dat 'n stroom 'n magneetveld maak.

questions.q: What is South Africa's mains electricity supply?
questions.qAf: Wat is Suid-Afrika se hoofnetwerk-elektrisiteitstoevoer?
questions.explain: Mains electricity is alternating current: 230 V, reversing direction 50 times a second (50 Hz).
questions.explainAf: Hoofnetwerk-elektrisiteit is wisselstroom: 230 V, wat 50 keer per sekonde van rigting verander (50 Hz).

questions.q: To which of Earth's spheres does a glacier belong?
questions.qAf: Aan watter van die Aarde se sfere behoort 'n gletser?
questions.explain: The hydrosphere is all the water on, under and above Earth's surface, including ice and water vapour.
questions.explainAf: Die hidrosfeer is al die water op, onder en bo die Aarde se oppervlak, insluitend ys en waterdamp.

questions.q: Wind and temperature changes slowly break down rock. Which two spheres are interacting?
questions.qAf: Wind en temperatuurveranderinge breek rots stadig af. Watter twee sfere is in wisselwerking?
questions.explain: This is weathering: the air (atmosphere) breaking down rock (lithosphere).
questions.explainAf: Dit is verwering: die lug (atmosfeer) wat rots (litosfeer) afbreek.

sections.title: Give ONE word or term
sections.intro: Write ONE word or term for each description.
sections.introAf: Skryf EEN woord of term vir elke beskrywing.

questions.q: The organ in which most digested food is absorbed into the blood.
questions.qAf: Die orgaan waarin die meeste verteerde voedsel in die bloed opgeneem word.

questions.q: The female organ in which a baby develops.
questions.qAf: Die vroulike orgaan waarin ’n baba ontwikkel.

questions.q: The negatively charged particles that move around the nucleus of an atom.
questions.qAf: Die negatief gelaaide deeltjies wat om die kern van ’n atoom beweeg.

questions.q: A base that dissolves in water.
questions.qAf: ’n Basis wat in water oplos.

questions.q: The flow of electric charge in a circuit.
questions.qAf: Die vloei van elektriese lading in ’n stroombaan.

questions.q: The layer of gases that surrounds the Earth.
questions.qAf: Die laag gasse wat die Aarde omring.

sections.title: Fill in the missing words
sections.intro: Type the word that is missing in each space.
sections.introAf: Tik die woord wat in elke spasie ontbreek.

questions.q: Fill in the missing words.
questions.qAf: Vul die ontbrekende woorde in.
questions.text: The human heart has [[]] chambers. Valves in the heart stop blood from flowing [[]].
questions.textAf: Die menslike hart het [[]] kamers. Kleppe in die hart keer dat bloed [[]] vloei.

questions.q: Fill in the missing words.
questions.qAf: Vul die ontbrekende woorde in.
questions.text: Metals react with acids to form a [[]] and hydrogen gas. Metal oxides react with acids to form a salt and [[]].
questions.textAf: Metale reageer met sure om ’n [[]] en waterstofgas te vorm. Metaaloksiede reageer met sure om ’n sout en [[]] te vorm.

questions.q: Fill in the missing words.
questions.qAf: Vul die ontbrekende woorde in.
questions.text: Electricity from power stations reaches our homes through the national [[]]. Most of South Africa’s electricity is generated by burning [[]].
questions.textAf: Elektrisiteit van kragstasies bereik ons huise deur die nasionale [[]]. Die meeste van Suid-Afrika se elektrisiteit word opgewek deur [[]] te verbrand.

sections.title: True or false
sections.intro: Decide whether each statement is true or false.
sections.introAf: Besluit of elke stelling waar of onwaar is.

questions.q: Birds reproduce by external fertilisation in water.
questions.qAf: Voëls plant voort deur eksterne bevrugting in water.
questions.explain: False. Birds, reptiles and mammals use internal fertilisation. Fish and frogs fertilise their eggs externally, in water.
questions.explainAf: Onwaar. Voëls, reptiele en soogdiere gebruik interne bevrugting. Visse en paddas bevrug hul eiers ekstern, in water.

questions.q: Covalent molecular substances such as water and carbon dioxide generally have low melting and boiling points.
questions.qAf: Kovalente molekulêre stowwe soos water en koolstofdioksied het oor die algemeen lae smelt- en kookpunte.
questions.explain: True. The forces between separate molecules are weak, so little energy is needed to separate them.
questions.explainAf: Waar. Die kragte tussen afsonderlike molekules is swak, dus is min energie nodig om hulle te skei.

questions.q: If you cut a bar magnet in half, you get one piece that is only a north pole and one that is only a south pole.
questions.qAf: As jy 'n staafmagneet middeldeur sny, kry jy een stuk wat net 'n noordpool is en een wat net 'n suidpool is.
questions.explain: False. You cannot isolate a single pole. Each half becomes a complete magnet with its own N and S pole.
questions.explainAf: Onwaar. Jy kan nie 'n enkele pool isoleer nie. Elke helfte word 'n volledige magneet met sy eie N- en S-pool.

questions.q: Earth is about 4.6 billion years old.
questions.qAf: Die Aarde is ongeveer 4,6 miljard jaar oud.
questions.explain: True. Geologists divide this huge span into eons, eras, periods and epochs.
questions.explainAf: Waar. Geoloë verdeel hierdie groot tydperk in eone, eras, periodes en epogge.

sections.title: Matching
sections.intro: Match column A to column B, and find the matching pairs.
sections.introAf: Pas kolom A by kolom B, en vind die pare wat bymekaar pas.

questions.q: Match each seed in column A with how it is dispersed in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke saad in kolom A by hoe dit versprei word in kolom B.
questions.explain: Light seeds with parachutes blow away, buoyant coconuts float across oceans, and hooked seeds cling to fur and clothes.
questions.explainAf: Ligte sade met valskermpies waai weg, drywende klappers dryf oor oseane, en sade met hakies klou aan pels en klere vas.

questions.q: Find the matching pairs: link each substance to the type of bonding in it.
questions.qAf: Vind die pare wat bymekaar pas: koppel elke stof aan die soort binding daarin.
questions.explain: MgO is a metal with a non-metal (ionic), CO₂ is two non-metals (covalent), and copper is a metal on its own (metallic).
questions.explainAf: MgO is 'n metaal met 'n nie-metaal (ionies), CO₂ is twee nie-metale (kovalent), en koper is 'n metaal op sy eie (metaalbinding).

sections.title: Steps in order
sections.intro: Put the steps in the correct order.
sections.introAf: Plaas die stappe in die korrekte volgorde.

questions.q: Put the parts of the national electricity supply system in order, from the power station to the user.
questions.qAf: Plaas die dele van die nasionale elektrisiteitsvoorsieningstelsel in volgorde, van die kragstasie tot die gebruiker.
steps: Transmission on the national grid at high voltage
Distribution by the municipality at a lower voltage
The end user: homes, schools and businesses
stepsAf: Oordrag op die nasionale netwerk teen hoë spanning
Verspreiding deur die munisipaliteit teen 'n laer spanning
Die eindgebruiker: huise, skole en besighede
questions.explain: Generation → transmission → distribution → end user. If any part cannot keep up, the whole system is affected.
questions.explainAf: Opwekking → oordrag → verspreiding → eindgebruiker. As enige deel nie kan byhou nie, word die hele stelsel geraak.

sections.title: Calculation and short answers
sections.intro: Show the answer in the box. For the written question you mark your own answer against the memo after you hand in.
sections.introAf: Gee die antwoord in die blokkie. Vir die geskrewe vraag merk jy jou eie antwoord teen die memorandum nadat jy ingehandig het.

questions.q: An electric heater with a power of 2 kW is switched on for 3 hours. How much electrical energy does it use, in kilowatt-hours?
questions.qAf: ’n Elektriese verwarmer met ’n drywing van 2 kW word vir 3 uur aangeskakel. Hoeveel elektriese energie gebruik dit, in kilowatt-uur?

questions.q: Give TWO reasons why burning coal to generate electricity harms the environment.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE redes waarom die verbranding van steenkool om elektrisiteit op te wek die omgewing benadeel.
points: It releases carbon dioxide, which adds to the greenhouse effect and global warming
It releases sulfur dioxide, ash or soot that cause acid rain, air pollution or breathing problems (mining also damages the land)
pointsAf: Dit stel koolstofdioksied vry, wat bydra tot die kweekhuiseffek en aardverwarming
Dit stel swaeldioksied, as of roet vry wat suurreën, lugbesoedeling of asemhalingsprobleme veroorsaak (mynbou beskadig ook die land)

sections.title: Scenarios
sections.intro: Read each scenario, then answer the questions about it.
sections.introAf: Lees elke scenario en beantwoord dan die vrae daaroor.

questions.scenario: When you breathe in, the diaphragm and the intercostal muscles between the ribs both contract.
questions.scenarioAf: Wanneer jy inasem, trek die middelrif en die interkostale spiere tussen die ribbes albei saam.

questions.q: What does the diaphragm do as it contracts?
questions.qAf: Wat doen die middelrif wanneer dit saamtrek?
options: It pushes the ribs down and in
optionsAf: Dit word plat en beweeg af
Dit druk die ribbes af en in
questions.explain: The diaphragm contracts and flattens, moving down, while the ribs move up and out.
questions.explainAf: Die middelrif trek saam en word plat, en beweeg af, terwyl die ribbes op en uit beweeg.

questions.q: What happens to the volume and pressure inside the chest?
questions.qAf: Wat gebeur met die volume en druk in die borskas?
options: The volume increases and the pressure decreases, so air rushes in
The volume decreases and the pressure increases, so air is pushed out
The volume and the pressure both increase
optionsAf: Die volume neem toe en die druk neem af, dus stroom lug in
Die volume neem af en die druk neem toe, dus word lug uitgedruk
Die volume en die druk neem albei toe
questions.explain: A bigger chest volume lowers the pressure inside, so air flows in from outside, where the pressure is higher.
questions.explainAf: 'n Groter borsvolume verlaag die druk binne, dus vloei lug van buite in, waar die druk hoër is.

questions.q: The lungs have their own muscles that pull air in.
questions.qAf: Die longe het hul eie spiere wat lug intrek.
questions.explain: False. The lungs have no muscle. They fill and empty passively as the chest volume and pressure change.
questions.explainAf: Onwaar. Die longe het geen spiere nie. Hulle vul en leeg passief soos die borsvolume en druk verander.

questions.scenario: A learner drops marble chips (calcium carbonate) into hydrochloric acid and measures how fast carbon dioxide is given off.
questions.scenarioAf: 'n Leerder gooi marmerskilfers (kalsiumkarbonaat) in soutsuur en meet hoe vinnig koolstofdioksied afgegee word.

questions.q: She repeats it with the same mass of marble, but as a fine powder. What happens?
questions.qAf: Sy herhaal dit met dieselfde massa marmer, maar as 'n fyn poeier. Wat gebeur?
options: The reaction is faster, because there is more surface area
The reaction is slower, because powder is lighter
optionsAf: Die reaksie is vinniger, omdat daar meer oppervlakte is
Die reaksie is stadiger, omdat poeier ligter is
questions.explain: Smaller particles expose more surface to the acid, so there are more collisions and the reaction is faster.
questions.explainAf: Kleiner deeltjies stel meer oppervlak aan die suur bloot, dus is daar meer botsings en is die reaksie vinniger.

questions.q: Why does warming the acid speed up the reaction?
questions.qAf: Waarom versnel dit die reaksie om die suur te verwarm?
options: The particles move faster and collide more often and with more energy
Warm acid contains more acid particles
Heat turns the marble into a catalyst
It does not; temperature has no effect
optionsAf: Die deeltjies beweeg vinniger en bots meer dikwels en met meer energie
Hitte verander die marmer in 'n katalisator
Dit doen nie; temperatuur het geen effek nie
questions.explain: A higher temperature makes collisions more frequent and more energetic.
questions.explainAf: 'n Hoër temperatuur maak botsings meer gereeld en meer energiek.

questions.q: What is a catalyst?
questions.qAf: Wat is 'n katalisator?
options: A substance that speeds up a reaction without being used up
A reactant that is used up first
A substance that stops a reaction
The gas a reaction gives off
optionsAf: 'n Stof wat 'n reaksie versnel sonder om opgebruik te word
questions.explain: For example, MnO₂ speeds up the decomposition of H₂O₂ and is still there at the end.
questions.explainAf: Byvoorbeeld, MnO₂ versnel die ontbinding van H₂O₂ en is aan die einde steeds daar.

questions.scenario: A volcano erupts, sending lava, ash and gases out. Ash rises into the sky and later falls into rivers.
questions.scenarioAf: 'n Vulkaan bars uit en stuur lawa, as en gasse uit. As styg in die lug op en val later in riviere.

questions.q: The volcano itself is part of which sphere?
questions.qAf: Die vulkaan self is deel van watter sfeer?
questions.explain: The volcano is part of the solid, rocky lithosphere.
questions.explainAf: Die vulkaan is deel van die vaste, rotsagtige litosfeer.

questions.q: How can the ash in the sky affect the climate for a while?
questions.qAf: Hoe kan die as in die lug die klimaat vir 'n ruk beïnvloed?
options: It can block sunlight and cool the climate
It adds water to the oceans
It has no effect on the atmosphere
optionsAf: Dit kan sonlig blokkeer en die klimaat afkoel
Dit voeg water by die oseane
Dit het geen effek op die atmosfeer nie
questions.explain: Volcanic ash and gases in the atmosphere can block sunlight and temporarily cool the climate.
questions.explainAf: Vulkaniese as en gasse in die atmosfeer kan sonlig blokkeer en die klimaat tydelik afkoel.

questions.q: When the ash falls into rivers, which sphere is affected next?
questions.qAf: Wanneer die as in riviere val, watter sfeer word volgende geraak?
questions.explain: Ash in rivers and oceans affects water quality in the hydrosphere.
questions.explainAf: As in riviere en oseane beïnvloed die watergehalte in die hidrosfeer.

questions.q: Fish and plants in those rivers may be harmed, so the eruption also affects the biosphere.
questions.qAf: Visse en plante in daardie riviere kan skade ly, dus raak die uitbarsting ook die biosfeer.
questions.explain: True. A change in one sphere ripples through all the others: Earth behaves as one connected system.
questions.explainAf: Waar. 'n Verandering in een sfeer versprei deur al die ander: die Aarde tree op as een verbonde stelsel.
